planets.name: TOI-1694 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1694 with a 3.77-day year, found in 2023.

text.card: TOI-1694 b was found in 2023 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around TOI-1694. Its orbit and size follow Mancini et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
